general.notes: Datasheet distributed via https://www.amphenol-cs.com/optics.html while footer identifies XGIGA Communication Technology Co.,ltd. Total Output Average Launch Power and several electrical parameters marked TBD. Transmit OMA per Lane (min) is 0.8 dBm for TDECQ<0.9 dB and -0.1+TDECQ dBm for 0.9 dB≤TDECQ≤3.4 dB. Receiver Sensitivity (OMA) per Lane is -4.6+TECQ dBm for 0.9 dB≤TECQ≤SECQ (formula; SECQ not numerically defined in excerpt). Receiver sensitivity measured with PRBS31Q, BER 2.4×10^-4 per Optical Characteristics Note 2. Host must implement FEC; FEC type not specified on module. Supply Current Icc listed as 9090 mA at Vcc 3.3 V as printed. Signaling speed tolerance ± 50 ppm. Case temperature 0–70 °C without air flow. Optical receiver damage threshold 5.9 dBm per lane (Absolute Maximum Ratings and Optical Characteristics). Average launch Power off per lane max -16 dBm. RIN17.1 OMA max -139 dB/Hz.
